jobs.name: react-ui-patterns

Create a clean app-style icon set for a developer skill named "React UI Patterns".

Style profile: frontend
Palette direction: Cobalt + cyan + electric mint accents
Motif direction: Layout grids, viewport frames, component blocks, motion arcs
